glosses: curiosity; inquisitiveness (the tendency to want to investigate things)
curiosity (an interesting object or piece of information)
indiscretion (lack of respect for other’s privacy)

examples.en: I did it out of curiosity.
I only ask out of curiosity.

examples.text: Só por curiosidade, o que você faria?
examples.en: Just out of curiosity, what would you do?
